full_transcription.scope: CPU waveform -> CPU text, transfers/frontend/encoder/optimized decoder; one warmed shape cached per model; no disk I/O/compile/capture; two resident models, not deployment VRAM

families.name: compiler
families.outcome: Register caps, saturation removal, cache policy, prefetch and launch bounds: no consistent full-encoder energy win; strong register caps regress.

families.name: geometry
families.outcome: 225 tile/split/warp/stage evaluations. Short QKV stages helped; general shape table had small latency gains and neutral energy.

families.name: compressed4
families.outcome: Column-major signed 4-bit weights expanded in registers: no tested shape beat INT8 storage.

families.name: compressed2
families.outcome: Column-major 2-bit weights expanded in registers: no tested shape beat INT8 storage.

families.name: exact_int4
families.outcome: Exact high/low nibble decomposition, separate/merged accumulators: 4-7x slower; disassembly shows PTX INT4 lowered to INT8 MMAs and unpacking on this SM120 build.

families.name: triton_groups2
families.outcome: Batched Triton K reductions lowered to SIMT, losing Tensor Core layout; slower.

families.name: triton_groups4
families.outcome: Batched Triton K reductions lowered to SIMT, losing Tensor Core layout; slower.

families.name: native_groups2
families.outcome: Actual CUDA/PTX program replication retains Tensor Cores: useful short mix/gate gains, retained in winner.

families.name: native_groups4
families.outcome: No wins; many configurations exceed the GPU shared-memory ceiling.

microbenchmark_experiments.scope: Synthetic resident prequantized dot products plus the same reconstruction epilogue. Excludes activation quantization and packing; no full-encoder or energy claim from micro timings.

power_policy: No power-limit or clock modifications; cap checked during every experiment.
precision: Trained ternary weights and scales unchanged; three residual INT8 activation components retained. FP32 reduction order changes; encoder output is not bitwise identical.
successful_changes: Short-sequence QKV pipeline stages increased to three.
Short mix/gate projections use two 128-thread programs in a 256-thread CTA with exact INT32 reduction across programs before FP32 conversion.
Projection epilogue, residual, next normalization and three-component residual INT8 quantization fused into row kernels.
Row kernel uses eight warps for M<=192, four for larger row counts.
timing_scope: Warmed batch-one graph replay; compilation, capture, and audio file I/O excluded.

memcheck.scope: Compute Sanitizer 12.9.79 memcheck; API-error reporting disabled. Bias ABI, compressed layouts, native integer reduction, row fusion, changed-input graph replay and allocator churn.

synccheck.scope: Native grouped CUDA integer reduction and changed-input graph/allocator-churn test.
